GANGSTER STATE FINAL SCRIPT TX SUNDAY 7TH APRIL 2019 FOR MIX


Commentary One
A year ago, investigative journalist Pieter Louis Myburgh quit his job, organised a grant and set off to examine the state capture networks that had laid waste to the FREE STATE.

Headline whoosh

Last Sunday his book, Gangster State, hit the headlines

Commentary two
And it’s no accident, ANC Secretary General Ace Magashule is on the cover

Devi
What conclusions do you reach about Ace Magashule?
PLM
That he undeniably acted like a fully-fledged gangster in a position of power.

Commentary Three
Magashule’s initial power came from his role as Chairperson of the Free State ANC, but neither Presidents Mandela or Mbeki would make him Premier, and in 2004 he was overlooked once again when Beatrice Marshoff got the top Job

Devi
Did he have ambitions to be premier in 2004
Beatrice Marshoff
He always had. He could not work through the fact that he had been sidestepped and he was always very angry

Commentary Four
Magashule had to make do with working as an MEC under Marshoff and during that time she fired him twice. Myburgh’s book tells the story

Pieter Louis
And that’s a story that is just another example that AceMagashule conducted himself as an outright thug while he was in provincial government.

Commentary Five
Marshoff recalls how Ace Magashule gave instructions to slaughter the cattle that belonged to the Glen agricultural college and hand out the meat as food parcels at an ANC meeting.

Devi
What did you do?
Beatrice
I said you need to stop them they can’t take the meat it doesn’t belong to ACE
Devi
How do we know for sure that was Ace’s decision that people acted on his instruction?
Beatrice
Nobody would have done that without the instructions of the MEC or the HOD.

Commentary six
In 2009 President Zuma gave Magashule what he wanted, the Premiership. Magashule resigned when he was voted in as Secretary General at Nasrec

Devi
When he was voted in as SG, what went through your mind?
Beatrice
I just thought oh my God it can’t be true? It’s not good for the ANC or the country because what Ace wants, Ace gets.

Commentary seven
Free State struggle veteran Dennis Bloem left the ANC in 2009. He has known Ace Magashule since the 80’s
Dennis
He knows how to manipulate people that is why at Nasrec he slipped through. He is very slippery.

Commentary eight
For years allegations have abounded about Magashules’s malfeasance and patronage, earning him the title Mr. Ten percent

Devi
Is it true that Ace Magashule handed out jobs in order to secure patronage?
Beatrice
That is true. Even the cleaners and general workers would not be appointed without Ace’s go ahead and approval

Commentary nine
But nothing ever sticks

Beatrice
There is nothing that points directly to ACE. ACE has always been very shrewd at that. Ace would give you instructions without putting pen to paper

Commentary Ten
But Myburgh claims this time, he can clearly reveal links between Magashule and a corrupt tender of R255 million that drained the coffers of Free State’s human settlements department.

LINK
It was an audit to determine which Free State houses had asbestos rooves. But Myburgh says the Free State government already had that information anyway, and this was just a plot to plunder
Commentary eleven
Tenderpreneur Igo Mpambani was the conduit. He was gunned down in Sandton in 2017 with a million rand in cash in his Bentley, but before his death, Myburgh claims he was Ace’s bagman.

Pieter Louis
They were paid in tranches, R10 million rand, R15 million rand, R20 million the money keeps on flushing into Mpambani’s pockets. At key moments Ace Magushele’s PA then contact Mpambani via email and tell him how to spend the money on the instruction of ACE Magashule. Even more concerning is the fact that at key moments too, Igo Mpambani receives instructions and makes certain donations to the ruling ANC. In other words, this is a money laundering chain. THE Department of Human Settlements pays our taxpayers money to Igo Mpambani. This is a previously untold scandal on the scale of the Vrede dairy scandal.

Commentary twelve
It was painstaking work. Myburgh got hold of Magashule’s official diary, then through toll payments, ATM withdrawals and bank statements he was able to match the movements of the two men. He also relied heavily on a spreadsheet that he concluded was a blueprint for bribes

Piet Louis Myburgh
Igo Mpambani at some point before his death exchanged emails with one of his partners and it included a spreadsheet they called it a cost of business spreadsheet, and it literally showed how this R255 million would be carved up between certain individuals in this project. A certain AM was due to get R10 million rand, and it very clearly shows that only a fraction of it was going to be paid to the subcontractor who was going to do the work on the ground.

Commentary thirteen
Before publication Myburgh sent Magashule a list of 60 questions
Devi
How did he respond?
PLM
He responded by not responding

Commentary fourteen
But when the book hit the headlines last week, Magashule called it fake news and is now considering his legal options.

Link
And the ANC came out guns blazing defending their SG. They say it is a vicious character assassination campaign, and it is the opening propaganda salvo in a carefully planned Stratcom operation

Commentary fifteen
We sent a separate list of questions to Magashule’s office. They say:
the questions are not objective or fair and are geared towards perpetuating a false narrative based on fabrications and lies about the Secretary General. Your attempts to target and isolate him have not gone unnoticed but he remains firm and unshaken and focused on securing a landslide victory in the upcoming elections

Commentary sixteen
Myburgh’s investigation also unearthed what he calls Magashule’s struggle fibs

Pieter Louis
So Ace Magashule drew political capital from a claim he made that he was a treason trialist. That doesn’t check out at all.

Commentary seventeen
He claimed that he was on the National executive committee of the UDF. Not so says Dennis Bloem

DENNIS BLOEM
ACE was never there, I will repeat and repeat and repeat. Ace was never an executive member of the United Democratic Front.

Commentary eighteen
Bloem is the real deal and gets emotional when he looks back at these photos of himself with Oliver Tambo

Dennis Bloem
And many of us can’t sit around one table with ACE, because we know, and he knows that this is are the real freedom fighters. He came in through dubious ways into these positions. He knows very well he is not an honest man

Commentary nineteen
On Friday Former MEC Mxolisi Dukwana testified at the Zondo commission that Tony Gupta told him he paid Magashule a million rand a month

Dukwana
I drive to Ace Magashule’s place and I give him his million.

Thabo Manyoni, the former Bloemfontein mayor related his visit to the Gupta’s to Myburgh

Pieter Louis Myburgh
TEA with ATUL tells the story of Thabo Manyoni, the then mayor of Bloemfontein. Manyoni tells us that Jacob Zuma had the idea of appointing Ace Magashule as the new minister of communications. Thabo Manyoni then would have come the Premier of the Free STATE and they then needed to sweet talk and assess and vet Thabo Manyoni

Commentary twenty
But the mayor wasn’t keen

Pieter Louis
The most concerning element of that visit is that Atul Gupta handed him a brown envelope and this was for organizational matters. Mr. Manyoni at least in the way he conveyed the story to me was horrified about the way in which the meeting was unfolding and he didn’t come across as somebody who was going to give his cooperation to ether Ace Magashule or the Gupta’s

Commentary twenty- one
Manyoni later lost his position as the mayor and his political career ended

Devi
How important an ally was Ace Magashule to the Gupta’s?
Pieter Louis
I think we with right can ask ourselves if he wasn’t a more important ally than Jacob Zuma.

Devi
You call him the Secretary Gangster. Should we be concerned?
Pieter Louis
We should be terrified

Commentary twenty- two
Bloem Agrees.

Dennis
ACE plan is to topple Cyril Ramaphosa and then take over the ANC for his own personal interest. That is going to happen, I can tell you now! That is their plan.

Commentary twenty- three
This week Magashule faced an onslaught of corruption allegations, but he is digging in and the ANC continue to defend their Secretary General

Pieter louis
I and the South African public, only ask of the law enforcement agencies to do proper investigations into allegations of corruption, regardless of how powerful the subject of those investigations are.
